items.title: Object to Kinderzuschlag decision (Widerspruch)
items.quote: Innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe kann gegen diesen Bescheid Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei: Familienkasse Musterlahn, Bahnhofsallee 40, 35576 Beispielwetzlar. Bei Versand mit der Post ist der Bescheid am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post bekannt gegeben.
items.computation: Bescheid dated/posted 20.11.2026 (Friday); no separate 'Aufgabe zur Post' date stated, so the printed Bescheid date is the posting day. 4th day after posting (calendar days, posting day not counted): 21 Nov (Sat), 22 Nov (Sun), 23 Nov (Mon), 24 Nov (Tue) -> deemed delivered 24.11.2026. The Familienkasse acting for Kinderzuschlag is a social-law body under SGB X, so the delivery day is NOT shifted even though it falls on a day count that could include a weekend (here 24 Nov is itself a Tuesday, no issue anyway). One-month Widerspruch period (§84 SGG) starts with delivery day 24.11.2026 (that day itself not counted per §187 Abs.1 BGB) and ends one month later on the day with the same number (§188 Abs.2 BGB): 24.12.2026 (Thursday). 24 December is a normal working day in Germany (not a statutory holiday), so no further adjustment under §193 BGB is needed.
